statement: Initial table provisioning retains each planned replica-operation execution command until that exact command either owns one serialized operation-lane turn or observes durable forward/terminal progress, so a concurrent CDC/bootstrap wake cannot coalesce the inline command away, no planned row times out in PENDING, and three consecutive fresh MovieLens runs report priority metric 0.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Reuse the existing per-operation DurableWorkflowCoordinator owner lane and its authoritative workflow transitions. Do not add a parallel queue, timer, watchdog, or target-side workflow writer.

A lane holder result or rejection belongs to that holder. The initial-partition caller may accept only its own executed command or authoritative evidence that the exact operation has moved beyond PENDING or become terminal; unrelated holder success and operation_already_executing are not provisioning success.
Keep ordinary concurrent executeOperation deduplication unchanged. The retained-turn contract is explicit to initial partition provisioning and must not make generic duplicate callers dispatch twice.

Before source acceptance, a deterministic production-seam test must hold the exact operation lane across the bootstrap-topology persistence handoff, prove the planned inline command is not discarded, and prove reverting the production change leaves the row PENDING with no dispatch.

Do not change replica-operation deadlines, retry or transition budgets, gateway timeouts, concurrency limits, schema stability windows, MovieLens workload, preload size, affinity scoring, live runner ordering, or report predicates.

After deterministic, focused, static, model, and verifier gates pass, use the unchanged ordered live runner: five formation probes must pass before three measuring MovieLens repetitions; stop on the first red, preserve immutable stopped-state evidence, and do not make an unchanged rerun.

The 2026-07-20T03:16:02.506Z stopped run is the witness: dc99...:operation:ade39472 was durably PENDING with its reservation, received no SENDING/dispatch transition while sibling planned operations ran, timed out after 30524ms, and the schema retry then collided with that retained FAILED row.
